_note: One entry per league. Its files are in site/<id>/ (games/, mock/, img/, theme.css). theme_css: the league's own colours over style.css's default theme (leave it out for the default); theme: the browser bar colour. After any change run python -I tools/build_pages.py: it writes site/<id>/index.html and the landing page site/index.html. palette: the default theme's starting palette (blastoise, charizard, venusaur), for a league without theme_css. brackets: the league's Challonge tournaments (name, slug), newest first, shown under Games. best_of: games in a set when the league plays sets every week (3 = best of three; unlabelled games of a week between the same two players are then grouped as one set). Without it, only games labelled with a set (index.json set, add_game.py --set) are grouped.
